description: The donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” illustrates the distribution of 38 total stimuli used in the study, categorized by content format. The largest segment is “External News Article,” represented in dark green and accounting for 15 out of 38 stimuli (approximately 39.5%). The second largest is “Draft/Other,” in red, with 9 out of 38 (23.7%). “Email” follows in maroon with 5 out of 38 (13.2%), while “Press Release” in yellow accounts for 4 out of 38 (10.5%). Smaller segments include “Interview” in navy blue (2/38, ~5.3%), “Organizational Report” in purple (2/38, ~5.3%), and “Intra-agency news article” in orange (1/38, ~2.6%). Each segment is labeled with its category name and fractional count (x/38), and the chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions without additional percentage labels or exploded slices. The central white space contains the title “Stimuli Type,” and the overall layout is clean and color-coded for easy differentiation.
